mapper.sql: select m.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.material_type, m.category_name, m.unit_name, m.default_supplier_id, m.default_supplier_name, m.safe_stock_qty, ifnull(inv.current_stock_qty, 0) as current_stock_qty, m.status, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark from erp_material m left join ( select ms.material_id, sum(ifnull(i.available_qty, 0) + ifnull(i.locked_qty, 0)) as current_stock_qty from erp_material_sku ms left join erp_inventory i on i.item_type = '物料' and i.item_id = ms.material_sku_id group by ms.material_id ) inv on inv.material_id = m.material_id
mapper.select: where m.del_flag = '0' and (m.status is null or m.status = '' or m.status = '0') order by m.material_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_material( material_code, material_name, material_type, category_name, unit_name, default_supplier_id, default_supplier_name, safe_stock_qty, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{materialType}, #{categoryName}, #{unitName}, #{defaultSupplierId}, #{defaultSupplierName}, #{safeStockQty}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
